q: Complete the sentence: She ___ to music every evening.
question: Which verb form is correct?
hint: С he/she/it в Present Simple добавляем -s к глаголу!

q: Choose the correct negative: They ___ like carrots.
question: How to make this sentence negative?
hint: С they используем don't, а doesn't — только с he/she/it.

q: Complete the question: ___ you play the guitar?
question: Which word starts the question?
hint: С you в вопросах Present Simple используем Do.

q: Yesterday we ___ to the cinema.
question: Which verb shows past action?
hint: Go — неправильный глагол: go → went → gone.

q: Complete: He ___ his homework last night.
question: Which form is correct for Past Simple?
hint: Do — неправильный глагол: do → did → done.

q: Choose the correct sentence about now: Look! The dog ___ in the garden.
question: What is the dog doing now?
hint: Look! + am/is/are + verb-ing = действие сейчас.

q: Complete: I ___ a letter to my friend at the moment.
question: Which form shows action now?
hint: At the moment → Present Continuous: am/is/are + verb-ing.

q: Choose the future form: Tomorrow I ___ my grandparents.
question: Which verb shows future action?
hint: Tomorrow + will + глагол = будущее время.

q: Complete: She ___ go to school next Monday.
question: Which word shows future negative?
hint: Will not = won't — отрицание в будущем времени.

q: Choose the comparative: My bag is ___ than yours.
question: Which word compares two things?

q: Complete: This is the ___ book in the library.
question: Which word shows the highest degree?
hint: Длинные прилагательные: most + прилагательное = превосходная степень.

q: Choose the correct plural: one foot — two ___
question: What is the plural of 'foot'?
hint: Запомни исключения: foot → feet, tooth → teeth!

q: Complete: There ___ many apples on the table.
question: Which verb matches plural noun?
hint: There are + множественное число; There is + единственное.

q: Choose: There ___ a pencil in my bag.
question: Which verb matches singular noun?
hint: There is + один предмет.

q: Complete: I have ___ money in my wallet.
question: Which word is used with uncountable nouns?
hint: Much + неисчисляемые (money, water); Many + исчисляемые.

q: Choose: How ___ students are in your class?
question: Which word asks about countable things?
hint: How many + исчисляемые существительные во множественном числе.

q: Complete: The cat is sleeping ___ the sofa.
question: Which preposition shows position?
hint: On = на поверхности; in = внутри; at = в точке.

q: Choose: We meet ___ Saturday morning.
question: Which preposition is correct with day + part of day?
hint: On + день недели или часть дня с днём (on Monday, on Sunday morning).

q: Complete: She can ___ very fast.
question: Which form follows modal verb 'can'?
hint: После can/must/should глагол без -s и без to!

q: Choose the correct sentence: You ___ wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
question: Which modal verb shows obligation?
hint: Must = обязательно; can = могу; may = возможно.

q: Complete: This is ___ book. (Tom)
question: How to show possession?
hint: Имя + 's = чья вещь (притяжательный падеж).

q: Choose: Is this ___ pen or mine?
question: Which possessive pronoun is correct?
hint: Your + существительное; yours = без существительного (твой).

q: Complete: ___ is your favourite colour?
question: Which question word asks about things?
hint: What = что/какой; Who = кто; Where = где.

q: Choose: ___ do you go to school? — By bus.
question: Which word asks about method/transport?
hint: How = как/каким способом; What = что; When = когда.

q: Complete: I ___ eat vegetables every day.
question: Which adverb shows frequency?
hint: Always/usually/often/sometimes — наречия частоты для Present Simple.

q: Choose the correct order: She ___ gets up at 7 o'clock.
question: Where to place the adverb of frequency?
hint: Наречия частоты (always, usually) ставятся ПЕРЕД основным глаголом.

q: Complete: He is ___ than his brother.
question: Which form compares two people?
hint: Сравнительная степень: прилагательное + -er + than.

q: Choose: This is the ___ day of my life!
question: Which form shows the highest degree?
hint: Превосходная степень: the + прилагательное с -est (или most).

q: Complete: We ___ to the park last weekend.
question: Which verb form is correct for Past Simple?
hint: Last weekend → Past Simple; go → went (неправильный глагол).

q: Choose the correct question: ___ she like ice cream?
question: Which auxiliary verb is correct?
hint: С he/she/it в вопросах Present Simple используем Does.
